messages.content: You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model. Analyze authorized security test results and identify findings, severity, evidence, security impact, digital-trust impact, and recommended remediation. Do not generate attack instructions.

{"test_name":"SQL Injection Test","observation":"A database-backed search parameter accepted unsanitized input that altered the structure of the generated SQL query and returned records outside the intended search criteria."}

{"test_name":"SQL Injection Test","finding":"SQL Injection vulnerability allowing unauthorized database query manipulation.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Attackers may bypass application controls, access unauthorized database records, modify data, or potentially compromise the database depending on account privileges.","digital_trust_impact":"The application fails to reliably separate trusted application logic from untrusted database input.","recommendation":"Use parameterized queries or prepared statements, enforce strict server-side input validation, and ensure database accounts operate with least privilege."}

You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model. Analyze authorized security test results and identify findings, severity, evidence, security impact, digital-trust impact, and recommended remediation. Do not generate attack instructions.

{"test_name":"Stored XSS Test","observation":"User-controlled profile information was stored by the application and subsequently rendered in another user's browser without adequate output encoding, resulting in execution of attacker-controlled client-side content."}

{"test_name":"Stored XSS Test","finding":"Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in user profile functionality.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Attackers may execute client-side scripts in victims' browser contexts and potentially access data available to the affected session or manipulate application content.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not maintain a reliable boundary between untrusted user-generated content and executable browser content.","recommendation":"Apply context-aware output encoding, sanitize rich content using a strict allowlist, and deploy an appropriate Content Security Policy."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Broken Object Level Authorization Test","observation":"An authenticated user modified an object identifier in an API request and successfully retrieved another user's account resource despite having no ownership relationship with that resource."}

{"test_name":"Broken Object Level Authorization Test","finding":"Broken Object Level Authorization allowing unauthorized access to another user's resource.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Attackers can access sensitive resources belonging to other users by manipulating object references.","digital_trust_impact":"The API does not consistently enforce resource ownership and authorization at the server side.","recommendation":"Perform authorization checks for every object access and modification and never rely on client-controlled identifiers as proof of authorization."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Privilege Escalation Test","observation":"A standard user account was able to invoke an administrative API operation successfully even though the account was not assigned an administrative role."}

{"test_name":"Privilege Escalation Test","finding":"Vertical privilege escalation caused by missing server-side authorization enforcement.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Low-privileged users may perform administrative operations and potentially compromise application-wide confidentiality, integrity, and availability.","digital_trust_impact":"The application's role hierarchy cannot be trusted because privileged operations are not consistently protected.","recommendation":"Enforce server-side role and permission checks on every privileged endpoint and implement deny-by-default authorization."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Session Fixation Test","observation":"The session identifier remained unchanged after successful authentication, allowing the pre-authentication session context to persist after login."}

{"test_name":"Session Fixation Test","finding":"Session fixation vulnerability caused by failure to regenerate the session identifier after authentication.","severity":"high","confidence":0.96,"security_impact":"An attacker who can influence a pre-authentication session may be able to associate that session with the victim's authenticated state.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not establish a fresh trusted session boundary when authentication state changes.","recommendation":"Regenerate the session identifier after authentication and privilege changes, invalidate the previous session, and use secure server-side session management."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"JWT Validation Test","observation":"The API accepted authentication tokens without enforcing the expected signing algorithm and did not consistently validate issuer and audience claims."}

{"test_name":"JWT Validation Test","finding":"Insufficient JWT validation resulting in improperly trusted authentication tokens.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Improper token validation can allow unauthorized parties to submit forged, misissued, or otherwise untrusted authentication assertions.","digital_trust_impact":"The application cannot reliably distinguish legitimate authentication tokens from untrusted token material.","recommendation":"Explicitly allow only approved signing algorithms, validate issuer, audience, expiration, and relevant claims, and verify signatures using trusted key material."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Password Reset Token Test","observation":"A password reset token remained valid after the associated password had been changed and could be reused for additional password-reset operations."}

{"test_name":"Password Reset Token Test","finding":"Reusable password reset token allowing persistent account recovery access.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"A compromised password reset token may remain usable after account recovery and increase the risk of account takeover.","digital_trust_impact":"The password recovery mechanism does not reliably invalidate authentication material after a security-sensitive state change.","recommendation":"Use short-lived, cryptographically random, single-use reset tokens and invalidate outstanding recovery tokens after a successful password reset."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"CORS Configuration Test","observation":"The API reflected arbitrary Origin values in Access-Control-Allow-Origin responses while also permitting credentialed cross-origin requests."}

{"test_name":"CORS Configuration Test","finding":"Overly permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing configuration.","severity":"high","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Untrusted websites may be able to make authenticated cross-origin requests and access sensitive API responses.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not establish a reliable trust boundary between approved web origins and untrusted websites.","recommendation":"Use an explicit allowlist of trusted origins, never reflect arbitrary Origin values, and restrict credentialed CORS requests to required origins only."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"CSRF Protection Test","observation":"A state-changing account-management request was accepted from an unrelated origin without requiring a CSRF token or equivalent request-integrity control."}

{"test_name":"CSRF Protection Test","finding":"Cross-Site Request Forgery vulnerability in state-changing functionality.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers may cause authenticated users to unknowingly perform sensitive actions using their existing application session.","digital_trust_impact":"The application cannot reliably distinguish intentional user actions from requests induced by untrusted origins.","recommendation":"Implement robust CSRF protection for state-changing operations and configure authentication cookies with an appropriate SameSite policy."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"File Upload Security Test","observation":"The document upload endpoint accepted executable file types and stored uploaded content in a directory directly accessible by the web server."}

{"test_name":"File Upload Security Test","finding":"Unrestricted file upload allowing potentially executable server-side content.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Malicious uploaded content may result in unauthorized code execution or compromise of application resources depending on server configuration.","digital_trust_impact":"The application treats untrusted uploaded content as trusted server-managed content.","recommendation":"Restrict uploads to an explicit allowlist, validate file content independently of extensions, store files outside executable web roots, and apply restrictive server-side permissions."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Path Traversal Test","observation":"A file retrieval parameter accepted path manipulation and caused the application to return files located outside the intended document directory."}

{"test_name":"Path Traversal Test","finding":"Path Traversal vulnerability allowing access outside the intended filesystem boundary.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Attackers may read sensitive local files accessible to the application process.","digital_trust_impact":"The application fails to constrain user-controlled file references to their intended filesystem boundary.","recommendation":"Avoid constructing filesystem paths directly from user input, use server-side object identifiers, canonicalize paths, and enforce a strict permitted directory boundary."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Command Injection Test","observation":"A diagnostic parameter supplied to a server-side utility was incorporated into an operating-system command without adequate separation between user data and command syntax."}

{"test_name":"Command Injection Test","finding":"OS command injection vulnerability in server-side diagnostic functionality.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Successful exploitation may allow unauthorized operating-system commands to execute with the privileges of the affected application process.","digital_trust_impact":"Untrusted input crosses directly into a privileged operating-system execution boundary.","recommendation":"Avoid shell invocation where possible, use structured process APIs, enforce strict input validation, and run application services with minimal operating-system privileges."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"XML External Entity Test","observation":"An XML-processing endpoint resolved external entities supplied within submitted XML documents instead of rejecting or disabling external entity processing."}

{"test_name":"XML External Entity Test","finding":"XML External Entity processing vulnerability.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers may cause the server to access unintended local or remote resources through the XML parser.","digital_trust_impact":"The XML processing layer permits untrusted documents to influence resource resolution outside the application's intended trust boundary.","recommendation":"Disable external entity resolution and DTD processing where unnecessary, use hardened XML parser configurations, and validate submitted XML against an appropriate schema."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"API Mass Assignment Test","observation":"The account-update API accepted JSON properties that were not exposed by the user interface, including an authorization-related attribute normally controlled by administrators."}

{"test_name":"API Mass Assignment Test","finding":"Mass assignment vulnerability allowing modification of protected object properties.","severity":"high","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Attackers may modify security-sensitive attributes that should only be controlled by trusted administrative workflows.","digital_trust_impact":"The API implicitly trusts client-provided object fields instead of maintaining an explicit server-side security model.","recommendation":"Use explicit request schemas or allowlists for writable properties and reject security-sensitive fields from unprivileged requests."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"API Rate Limiting Test","observation":"A resource-intensive API endpoint permitted sustained high-volume requests without meaningful throttling or quota enforcement."}

{"test_name":"API Rate Limiting Test","finding":"Insufficient API rate limiting and resource-abuse protection.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers may consume excessive application resources, degrade availability, or automate sensitive operations at scale.","digital_trust_impact":"The API lacks adequate safeguards against automated abuse and uncontrolled resource consumption.","recommendation":"Implement endpoint-specific rate limits, quotas, concurrency controls, adaptive throttling, and monitoring for abnormal request patterns."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Security Headers Test","observation":"The application omitted recommended browser security controls including Content-Security-Policy and frame-embedding restrictions."}

{"test_name":"Security Headers Test","finding":"Missing or insufficient browser security headers.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.95,"security_impact":"Missing browser security controls can increase exposure to clickjacking, script injection, and other client-side attack scenarios.","digital_trust_impact":"The browser-facing security posture does not consistently communicate restrictive security policies to clients.","recommendation":"Deploy an appropriate Content-Security-Policy, frame-ancestors policy, Referrer-Policy, and other security headers based on application requirements."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"TLS Configuration Test","observation":"The externally accessible service supported obsolete TLS protocol versions and weak cipher configurations during the security assessment."}

{"test_name":"TLS Configuration Test","finding":"Weak transport-layer security configuration.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Weak protocol and cipher support can expose communications to downgrade or cryptographic attacks under applicable conditions.","digital_trust_impact":"Users cannot rely on modern cryptographic protections when communicating with the service.","recommendation":"Disable obsolete TLS versions and weak cipher suites, enforce modern TLS configurations, and periodically review cryptographic settings."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Error Handling Test","observation":"Malformed requests caused the application to return detailed exception messages containing internal filesystem paths, framework information, and database implementation details."}

{"test_name":"Error Handling Test","finding":"Verbose error messages resulting in sensitive information disclosure.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Exposed implementation details can help attackers identify application components and potential attack surfaces.","digital_trust_impact":"The application leaks internal operational information that should remain within trusted diagnostic systems.","recommendation":"Return generic client-facing errors, securely log detailed diagnostics on the server, and disable development-mode exception reporting in production."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Cloud IAM Configuration Test","observation":"The application workload was assigned a cloud IAM role containing permissions significantly broader than those required for its documented business functions."}

{"test_name":"Cloud IAM Configuration Test","finding":"Excessive cloud IAM privileges violating the principle of least privilege.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Compromise of the workload could provide unauthorized access to additional cloud resources and sensitive services.","digital_trust_impact":"The cloud environment does not sufficiently constrain the potential blast radius of an application compromise.","recommendation":"Reduce IAM permissions to the minimum required actions and resources, separate workloads by role, and periodically review effective permissions."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Secrets Exposure Test","observation":"An unintended deployment artifact exposed application configuration containing active credentials for an external service."}

{"test_name":"Secrets Exposure Test","finding":"Hard-coded secret exposure in an application deployment artifact.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Exposed credentials may allow unauthorized access to external systems and services.","digital_trust_impact":"Sensitive authentication material is not adequately segregated from distributable application artifacts.","recommendation":"Immediately rotate exposed credentials, remove secrets from application artifacts, use a dedicated secrets-management system, and implement automated secret scanning."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Open Redirect Test","observation":"A post-authentication redirect parameter accepted arbitrary external destinations and redirected users after successful login."}

{"test_name":"Open Redirect Test","finding":"Unvalidated open redirect vulnerability.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Attackers may abuse trusted application URLs to redirect users to malicious destinations and facilitate phishing or social-engineering attacks.","digital_trust_impact":"Users may incorrectly associate attacker-controlled destinations with the trusted application's identity.","recommendation":"Restrict redirects to approved relative paths or an explicit destination allowlist and reject untrusted external URLs."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Account Enumeration Test","observation":"The login and password-recovery workflows returned distinguishable responses depending on whether the supplied account identifier existed."}

{"test_name":"Account Enumeration Test","finding":"User account enumeration through authentication and password-recovery workflows.","severity":"low","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers can identify valid accounts, improving the efficiency of credential attacks and targeted phishing campaigns.","digital_trust_impact":"The application reveals unnecessary information about the existence of user identities.","recommendation":"Use consistent responses and timing where practical, apply appropriate rate limiting, and avoid exposing whether an account exists."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Logout Session Invalidation Test","observation":"After logout, a previously issued authenticated session remained usable for protected API requests."}

{"test_name":"Logout Session Invalidation Test","finding":"Improper session invalidation after logout.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"A stolen or previously established session may remain usable after the legitimate user believes access has been terminated.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not reliably honor the user's explicit request to terminate authenticated access.","recommendation":"Invalidate server-side sessions and applicable refresh tokens on logout, enforce session expiration, and revoke sensitive sessions following security events."}

{"test_name":"NoSQL Injection Test","observation":"A JSON-based authentication parameter accepted database query operators as input and the resulting database query returned a user record without requiring the expected credential value."}

{"test_name":"NoSQL Injection Test","finding":"NoSQL Injection vulnerability allowing authentication control bypass.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Attackers may bypass authentication and access accounts without valid credentials.","digital_trust_impact":"The authentication layer improperly trusts client-controlled data when constructing database queries.","recommendation":"Enforce strict input schemas and data types, reject database operators from user-controlled fields, and construct database queries exclusively from validated application parameters."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"OAuth Redirect URI Test","observation":"The OAuth authorization flow accepted a redirect destination that was not registered for the application and returned authorization results to that destination."}

{"test_name":"OAuth Redirect URI Test","finding":"Insufficient OAuth redirect URI validation.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Improper redirect validation may allow authorization responses or tokens to be delivered to an untrusted destination.","digital_trust_impact":"The identity provider integration does not reliably restrict authentication responses to approved application endpoints.","recommendation":"Require exact matching against pre-registered redirect URIs and reject unrecognized or dynamically constructed redirect destinations."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"OAuth PKCE Validation Test","observation":"A public OAuth client completed the authorization flow successfully without demonstrating possession of the expected PKCE verifier."}

{"test_name":"OAuth PKCE Validation Test","finding":"Missing or ineffective PKCE validation in OAuth authorization flow.","severity":"high","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"An authorization response may be accepted without sufficient proof that it originated from the legitimate client session, increasing the risk of authorization-code interception and misuse.","digital_trust_impact":"The OAuth implementation does not adequately bind authorization responses to the originating client transaction.","recommendation":"Generate a cryptographically random code verifier and challenge for each authorization transaction and require strict verifier validation during token exchange."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Refresh Token Rotation Test","observation":"A refresh token remained valid after it had already been exchanged for a new access token, and multiple subsequent exchanges using the original token were accepted."}

{"test_name":"Refresh Token Rotation Test","finding":"Refresh token reuse caused by missing token rotation or replay detection.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"A stolen refresh token may remain usable for extended periods and provide continued access to protected resources.","digital_trust_impact":"The authentication system does not reliably detect or contain reuse of long-lived authentication material.","recommendation":"Implement refresh token rotation, detect reuse of previously consumed tokens, revoke the associated token family when replay is detected, and apply appropriate expiration controls."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Authentication MFA Bypass Test","observation":"A protected account-management operation could be accessed after completing only the primary password authentication step, despite the account being configured to require multi-factor authentication."}

{"test_name":"Authentication MFA Bypass Test","finding":"Multi-factor authentication enforcement bypass on protected functionality.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers possessing a user's primary credential may access protected functionality without completing the required second authentication factor.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not consistently enforce its declared authentication assurance level across sensitive workflows.","recommendation":"Track MFA completion as an explicit server-side authentication state and require the appropriate assurance level before granting access to sensitive operations."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Password Change Authorization Test","observation":"An authenticated user could submit a password-change request for an account identifier different from the currently authenticated account."}

{"test_name":"Password Change Authorization Test","finding":"Broken authorization in password-change functionality.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"An attacker with a valid low-privilege session may be able to change another user's password and obtain unauthorized account access.","digital_trust_impact":"The account-management service fails to bind security-sensitive changes to the authenticated user's identity.","recommendation":"Derive the target account from the authenticated security context, require appropriate reauthentication, and enforce server-side authorization for all credential changes."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"API Function-Level Authorization Test","observation":"A standard user successfully invoked an API endpoint documented for administrative users and received the administrative response."}

{"test_name":"API Function-Level Authorization Test","finding":"Broken Function Level Authorization exposing administrative functionality to standard users.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Unauthorized users may access administrative functions and perform privileged operations.","digital_trust_impact":"The API does not consistently enforce the application's role-based access-control model.","recommendation":"Apply centralized server-side authorization middleware to administrative endpoints and verify required permissions before executing the requested operation."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"API Excessive Data Exposure Test","observation":"An API response returned internal account attributes and security-related metadata that were not required by the client interface."}

{"test_name":"API Excessive Data Exposure Test","finding":"Excessive data exposure through API responses.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Unnecessary internal attributes may expose sensitive information that can assist further attacks or violate privacy requirements.","digital_trust_impact":"The API exposes more information than users or client applications require, weakening data-minimization controls.","recommendation":"Define explicit response schemas, return only fields required by the consuming client, and review sensitive attributes for accidental exposure."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"API Inventory Test","observation":"An undocumented legacy API endpoint was discovered in production and remained accessible without the authentication controls applied to the current API version."}

{"test_name":"API Inventory Test","finding":"Unmanaged legacy API endpoint exposing an outdated security boundary.","severity":"high","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Attackers may target undocumented legacy functionality that lacks current authentication and authorization controls.","digital_trust_impact":"The organization does not maintain consistent security controls across its production API inventory.","recommendation":"Maintain an authoritative API inventory, remove obsolete endpoints, and ensure all retained APIs inherit current authentication, authorization, monitoring, and security policies."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"GraphQL Authorization Test","observation":"A GraphQL query allowed an authenticated standard user to request fields belonging to another user's private profile despite field-level authorization requirements."}

{"test_name":"GraphQL Authorization Test","finding":"Missing field-level authorization in GraphQL API.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Unauthorized users may retrieve sensitive fields that should be restricted by ownership or role.","digital_trust_impact":"The GraphQL layer does not consistently enforce authorization boundaries at the data-field level.","recommendation":"Implement resolver-level authorization, apply centralized policy enforcement, and expose only fields permitted for the authenticated principal."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"GraphQL Query Complexity Test","observation":"The GraphQL service accepted deeply nested and computationally expensive queries without depth, complexity, or execution-time limits."}

{"test_name":"GraphQL Query Complexity Test","finding":"Insufficient GraphQL query complexity and resource-consumption controls.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.96,"security_impact":"Resource-intensive queries may consume excessive CPU, memory, database connections, or application worker capacity and degrade service availability.","digital_trust_impact":"The API lacks adequate controls against resource-intensive client requests.","recommendation":"Implement query depth and complexity limits, execution timeouts, request quotas, and monitoring for anomalous query behavior."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Web Cache Poisoning Test","observation":"A cacheable application response incorporated an untrusted request component into response content, and the resulting response was subsequently served to other users."}

{"test_name":"Web Cache Poisoning Test","finding":"Web cache poisoning caused by unsafe handling of untrusted request components in cacheable responses.","severity":"high","confidence":0.94,"security_impact":"Attackers may cause malicious content or manipulated responses to be delivered to other users through shared caches.","digital_trust_impact":"The caching layer does not correctly distinguish trusted response variants from attacker-influenced request state.","recommendation":"Review cache keys and response variation rules, prevent untrusted request components from influencing cacheable content, and apply appropriate cache-control policies."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"HTTP Request Smuggling Test","observation":"The front-end proxy and back-end application server interpreted request framing inconsistently during authorized protocol validation testing."}

{"test_name":"HTTP Request Smuggling Test","finding":"Inconsistent HTTP request parsing between intermediary and backend components.","severity":"high","confidence":0.95,"security_impact":"Parser inconsistencies may allow request boundaries to be interpreted differently by infrastructure components, potentially bypassing security controls or affecting other users' requests.","digital_trust_impact":"The network stack does not maintain a consistent interpretation of HTTP requests across security boundaries.","recommendation":"Standardize HTTP parsing behavior across proxy and backend components, reject ambiguous request framing, and apply vendor-recommended request-smuggling protections."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Host Header Validation Test","observation":"Application-generated absolute URLs for account-management operations were constructed directly from the incoming Host header without validating it against an approved hostname."}

{"test_name":"Host Header Validation Test","finding":"Unvalidated Host header used in security-sensitive URL generation.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"An attacker may influence generated application URLs and potentially redirect users toward attacker-controlled destinations during security-sensitive workflows.","digital_trust_impact":"The application implicitly trusts a client-controlled network header when establishing trusted application URLs.","recommendation":"Use statically configured canonical hostnames or trusted environment configuration for security-sensitive URL generation and reject unexpected hostnames."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Directory Listing Test","observation":"A production web directory containing application-generated documents was accessible with directory indexing enabled, revealing filenames and metadata to unauthenticated users."}

{"test_name":"Directory Listing Test","finding":"Unrestricted directory listing exposing application files and metadata.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Unauthenticated users may enumerate files and discover sensitive documents or application artifacts that were not intended for public access.","digital_trust_impact":"The web server exposes internal resource organization beyond the application's intended information boundary.","recommendation":"Disable directory indexing, remove unnecessary files from web-accessible directories, and enforce application-level authorization for protected resources."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Backup File Exposure Test","observation":"A production server exposed an archived configuration file containing historical application settings through the web server."}

{"test_name":"Backup File Exposure Test","finding":"Publicly accessible backup artifact exposing application configuration.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Exposed backup files may disclose configuration details, credentials, source code, or other information useful for further compromise.","digital_trust_impact":"Deployment hygiene controls do not prevent sensitive operational artifacts from becoming publicly accessible.","recommendation":"Remove backup artifacts from web-accessible locations, implement deployment scanning for sensitive files, and store backups in controlled repositories."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Sensitive Data in URL Test","observation":"Password-reset identifiers and other security-sensitive values were included in URL query parameters and subsequently appeared in application access logs."}

{"test_name":"Sensitive Data in URL Test","finding":"Sensitive authentication material exposed through URL parameters and logging infrastructure.","severity":"high","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"Sensitive values in URLs may be disclosed through logs, browser history, referrer data, monitoring systems, or third-party infrastructure.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not adequately protect security-sensitive information across secondary data-processing systems.","recommendation":"Avoid placing secrets in URLs, use secure request bodies or dedicated authorization mechanisms, and review existing logs for exposed sensitive values."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Insecure Password Storage Test","observation":"Application database records showed user passwords stored using a fast general-purpose hash rather than a dedicated password hashing function with configurable computational cost."}

{"test_name":"Insecure Password Storage Test","finding":"Inadequate password hashing configuration exposing credentials to increased offline cracking risk.","severity":"critical","confidence":0.99,"security_impact":"If password data is obtained, weak or unsuitable password hashing can significantly reduce the effort required to recover user credentials.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not provide an appropriate cryptographic protection boundary for user authentication secrets.","recommendation":"Use a modern adaptive password hashing function such as Argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt with appropriate parameters and unique salts for each password."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Cryptographic Randomness Test","observation":"Security-sensitive verification tokens were generated using a predictable application-level random number source rather than a cryptographically secure random generator."}

{"test_name":"Cryptographic Randomness Test","finding":"Predictable security token generation due to insufficient cryptographic randomness.","severity":"high","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Attackers may be able to predict or reproduce security-sensitive tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected workflows.","digital_trust_impact":"The application relies on authentication and verification material that lacks sufficient unpredictability.","recommendation":"Generate security-sensitive tokens using a cryptographically secure random number generator and ensure sufficient entropy and token length."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Account Lockout Test","observation":"Repeated authentication failures against the same account produced no progressive delay, lockout, or equivalent abuse-control response."}

{"test_name":"Account Lockout Test","finding":"Insufficient account-level protection against repeated authentication failures.","severity":"high","confidence":0.98,"security_impact":"Attackers may perform sustained credential guessing or credential-stuffing attempts against individual accounts.","digital_trust_impact":"The authentication service lacks sufficient resilience against automated account-compromise attempts.","recommendation":"Implement adaptive throttling and risk-based controls while avoiding permanent lockouts that could enable denial-of-service against legitimate users."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.
{"test_name":"Session Timeout Test","observation":"An authenticated session remained valid substantially beyond the application's documented inactivity timeout period."}

{"test_name":"Session Timeout Test","finding":"Excessive authenticated session lifetime due to ineffective inactivity timeout enforcement.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.96,"security_impact":"A stolen or unattended authenticated session may remain usable for longer than the intended security window.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not consistently enforce its documented session-lifecycle security controls.","recommendation":"Implement server-side inactivity and absolute session timeouts and ensure expired sessions are rejected consistently across all protected endpoints."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Concurrent Session Management Test","observation":"A user could maintain multiple active sessions indefinitely, and the application provided no mechanism to review or revoke previously issued sessions."}

{"test_name":"Concurrent Session Management Test","finding":"Insufficient authenticated session management and revocation controls.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.94,"security_impact":"Compromised sessions may remain active without the user having visibility or the ability to revoke them.","digital_trust_impact":"Users lack sufficient control and transparency over active authentication sessions associated with their accounts.","recommendation":"Provide session visibility and revocation capabilities, enforce appropriate session lifetimes, and revoke sessions following credential or security-state changes."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"Clickjacking Test","observation":"A sensitive account-management page could be embedded within an external webpage because the application did not enforce a frame-embedding restriction."}

{"test_name":"Clickjacking Test","finding":"Clickjacking protection missing from sensitive application functionality.","severity":"medium","confidence":0.97,"security_impact":"Users may be visually deceived into interacting with sensitive application controls while viewing an attacker-controlled page.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not adequately protect sensitive user interactions from untrusted framing contexts.","recommendation":"Use Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors and appropriate X-Frame-Options behavior to restrict framing of sensitive application pages."}
You are a cybersecurity and digital-trust analysis model.

{"test_name":"MIME Sniffing Test","observation":"The web application returned user-uploaded content without an X-Content-Type-Options header and relied on browser interpretation of the supplied content type."}

{"test_name":"MIME Sniffing Test","finding":"Missing MIME-sniffing protection for user-controlled content.","severity":"low","confidence":0.95,"security_impact":"Browser content-type inference may cause uploaded or otherwise untrusted content to be interpreted differently from the server's declared media type.","digital_trust_impact":"The application does not explicitly constrain browser interpretation of untrusted content.","recommendation":"Set X-Content-Type-Options to nosniff and ensure accurate Content-Type headers are returned for all user-controlled resources."}
